rule.rule: Only periods whose original flags are special_free_throw_or_foul and/or overturned_review. Exclude everything through the final hazard. Restart after a later-clock ordinary missed field goal followed by an opposite-team defensive rebound, corroborated by that team’s next offensive action. The original parser must also anchor an episode at that rebound. Keep all individual episode exclusions.
rule.selection_limit: Eligibility is retrospective and the original possession IDs are inferred. These are recorded ordinary-event tails, not an authoritative possession feed or new season test.
rule.design_freeze: This rule and the first/second restart comparison are fixed before recovery model fitting or scoring.

fit.setting_rule: Reuse the frozen validation-selected context and Markov settings; use the diagnostic clock rule fixed earlier. No new tuning or winner selection.
fit.evaluation_limit: Exploratory refits and recovery sensitivity on reused 2025 data. The source eligibility rule was fixed before these fits.

limits: Ordinary tails after the last special/review event; hazardous plays remain excluded.
Eligibility is retrospective, and inferred episodes are not official possession labels.
Added records skew toward later period clocks. These are reused 2025 benchmarks.
No pass or movement locations, causal player credit, or fresh-season claims are inferred.
